access_notes.value: Calling the notebooks API requires an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise subscription/license, a Google Cloud project with the API enabled, and Cloud NotebookLM User/Admin IAM roles; the only low-friction route is a 14-day, 5,000-license free trial, after which a paid monthly or annual subscription is required. The API itself is Preview (v1alpha) and subject to Pre-GA terms; contacting sales is only required above 5,000 licenses.

verdict_reason: Google publishes documented REST API methods for notebooks (google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha), but the surface is in Preview/Pre-GA and labeled as possibly having limited support. Access requires an enterprise subscription/license plus Cloud NotebookLM IAM roles, with only a 14-day, 5,000-license trial available before paid monthly/annual licensing. That plan-tier gating and narrow, alpha-status scope make it moderate rather than easy.
open_questions: Official NotebookLM-specific MCP server not found. Google documents a vendor MCP server at https://discoveryengine.googleapis.com/mcp (source S8), but its listed tools are search, conversational_search, and list_engines only; it does not document notebook-management MCP tools.

The NotebookLM API reference page (google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha) reportedly lists authorization scopes (cloud-platform, discoveryengine.readwrite), but the fetched text did not include that section; verify the exact documented scope list.

Rate limits/quota numbers for the NotebookLM API were not documented in the fetched pages; the 500 notebooks-per-user and 300 sources-per-notebook figures are product usage limits, not API rate limits.
No webhook/event-callback mechanism was documented in any fetched source.

No official NotebookLM SDK/client libraries were documented; examples use curl with gcloud-printed access tokens. Confirm whether generated Discovery Engine client libraries are officially supported for notebooklm.v1alpha.
No separate sandbox/test environment was documented; confirm whether a 14-day trial subscription can be used for non-production testing.
Community MCP server https://github.com/PleasePrompto/notebooklm-mcp was surfaced only in search results and was not fetched/verified.

Naming ambiguity: NotebookLM Enterprise has been renamed Gemini Notebook Enterprise, but the subscription name remains NotebookLM Enterprise and the API namespace is google.cloud.notebooklm.v1alpha; the personal NotebookLM product has no separate public API in the evidence.
